h1: Golf Carts for Sale in Spruce Creek
lead: Live in a Spruce Creek community? Masters Golf Cars sells carts to folks in Del Webb Spruce Creek, Spruce Creek South, and Spruce Creek Preserve. We have been at it since 1999.
Our shop is at 12885 S US Highway 441 in Belleview. That is just off County Road 475A, close to I-75. We sell Club Car, Yamaha, and EZ-GO. New and used. We fix carts too.

sections.h2: Why Spruce Creek Picks Masters Golf Cars

p: There are three Spruce Creek spots near Summerfield and Belleview. Del Webb Spruce Creek is the big one with the golf course. Spruce Creek South is gated and quiet. Spruce Creek Preserve has nature trails. We sell carts to all three.
Masters Golf Cars opened in 1999. People in Marion County know us. We sell fair and fix things right. Your neighbors have bought from us. Ask around.
We are on US-441 in Belleview. From Del Webb Spruce Creek, take County Road 475A north. You will see us in about 10 minutes. Right across from the Market of Marion.
The original one. Has the Spruce Creek Golf & Country Club. Biggest of the three.
Gated 55+ spot. Quiet streets. Close to shops on US-441.
Nature lovers like this one. Has trails and woods. Very peaceful.
Do not want to pay all at once? We work with Sheffield Financial. You can pay month by month. Easy to apply online.

p: Want one with no miles? We have new carts from the top brands. Pick your colors. Pick your options. Get a full warranty.
